title: Experience Model v6: final common-prefix writer pilot contract
summary: Retain the complete v7 base and v8 amendments without changing the experiment. Make the already-normative one-manifest failure rule literal in the five acceptance tests: T01 injects every pre-panel and panel failure class and asserts the legal execution suffix; T04 freezes the lifecycle transition table plus branch/cell order; T05 verifies the actual suffix against it. This is the final ratification candidate.
system_thesis: One adapter-free four-task prefix is cloned into HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL; E alone trains a rank-16 q/v LoRA on verified immediate-improvement packet-to-action rows; both continue four acquisition tasks; four fixed syntactic targets compare H, E_ON, and same-E-state E_OFF. The pilot may release only literal audited values from one 7B GH200 manifest and cannot establish or diagnose general learning, efficacy, mechanism, semantic generalization, intelligent sleep, or a paper claim.

context_files.purpose: Controlling architecture deliberation, ratification, review, and GPU gates.
Verbatim owner direction for the simple controlled branch complementary to Fable.
Ratification-candidate graph, loops, claims, visibility, and tests retained except lifecycle-test wording.
Normative authority, failure, claim, audit, and fixture amendments retained exactly.
Cross-critique identifying the sole lifecycle-test obligation gap.
Adjudicated requirement for the sole v9 amendment.
Normative lifecycle-test and V6S9 namespace amendment.

nodes.before: v8 made global stop behavior normative but its structured tests did not enumerate every required injection and suffix assertion.
nodes.after: T01 covers every pre-panel ordinary/integrity failure and every panel-cell failure position; T04 freezes a complete lifecycle table and order; T05 checks the actual suffix against it.
nodes.rationale: Turns the last prose-only control into executable evidence without changing the experiment.

edges.before: A status could be reconstructed without proving that no forbidden post-failure work occurred.
edges.after: Every status is accepted only when the ordered actual execution suffix is the single suffix allowed by the prebound lifecycle table.
edges.rationale: Prevents branch salvage, continued learning, retry, or result release after a stopping failure.

loops.before: v8 runtime semantics were closed, but failure injection and postrun suffix verification were not literal acceptance-test obligations.
loops.after: Independently inject every registered failure boundary, freeze the production transition table and order, then replay the actual command/event/status trace against that table before release.
loops.trigger: T01 fixture execution, T04 exact-manifest review, and T05 actual-run audit.
loops.stop_condition: Every matrix row and actual suffix matches exactly, or the pilot remains unauthorized/unreleased.
loops.rationale: Closes the final constructibility finding with no new scientific loop.

claims.before: v8 already permitted only literal exact-run descriptions after T05.
claims.after: Retain that claim exactly; additionally require T05 to verify the actual legal stop/continuation suffix before any status or value is released.
claims.evidence_needed: Exact composite architecture/run ratifications, passing V6S9 T01--T05, complete finite provenance, legal lifecycle suffix, and syntactic-holdout limitation.

claims.before: Any mechanism, effect-category, sufficiency, efficacy, generalization, continual-learning, or paper claim.
claims.after: Still forbidden; v9 adds no scientific inference.
claims.evidence_needed: A future registered replicated study outside this pilot.

cells.reason: Independent synthetic packet/lifecycle fixtures and no-model reset state only.
The model receives only the current canonical public packet.
Each call receives condition-local public state; the writer receives eligible common/E packets.
Each cell receives one target-local packet from its sealed snapshot.
The reviewer reconstructs packet/state transitions and their legal suffix.
The shared prefix has no condition or adapter object.
Adapter effects are below prompt; labels/rows/optimizer/telemetry remain offline.
Only assigned weights or NONE affect inference; labels and trainer state remain offline.
Rows/masks/updates/snapshots/adapter/mount hashes and lifecycle evidence are audited.
No target action/result exists; sealers inspect reset/baseline evidence only.
No target cell or learned target result exists.
No target result can reach life, memory, writer, or choice.
Cell receipts are offline-only and cannot enter another call or writer.
The reviewer opens cells after model execution and verifies legal continuation/stopping.

acceptance_tests.setup: An independent CPU oracle covers canonical state/action/fork semantics and injects ordinary/integrity failures at every pre-panel phase plus an ordinary/integrity failure at every final-cell position.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every pre-panel ordinary failure yields RUN_INCOMPLETE with no later call/action/update/publication/mount/cell/report; every integrity failure stops immediately with no values; panel ordinary failure alone continues remaining frozen cells once and yields PANEL_INCOMPLETE without aggregates or feedback.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The complete one-manifest transition and failure contract.

acceptance_tests.setup: An independent CPU fixture path reconstructs eligibility/dedup/order, literal tokenizer arrays/masks, update schedule, q/v inventory, optimizer order on toy tensors, and publication failures without production-helper imports.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every row/mask/update/module/failure matches frozen expectations and provenance proves oracle separation.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Unique and support-gated implementation of the minimal writer.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exactly two fresh CPU/no-model invocations enumerate and cold-reset unchanged local CompilerGym candidates using only the frozen algorithm.
acceptance_tests.expected: Byte-identical ordered 8/4 manifests; twelve unique URIs/bitcode hashes; exact repeated Autophase/I0/IOz; no model action, target result, Fable input, tuning, or substitution.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh reviewer and advocate inspect composite v9 bytes, implementation, T01--T03 evidence, independent fixture provenance, exact audit schemas, complete lifecycle transition table, frozen H/E branch and twelve-cell order, run manifest/commands/data paths, and quantitative 7B GH200 budget.
acceptance_tests.expected: The reviewer verifies production and fixtures implement the table and either approves the exact manifest for one human run decision or vetoes it.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Closure and feasibility of the controlled pilot.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh reviewer reconstructs every actual packet/action/state/memory/row/token/mask/update index/config/publication/mount/cell/rational score/status and compares the ordered actual suffix to the T04 lifecycle table, without floating-point retraining.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only a passing audit with the sole legal stop/continuation suffix releases status/raw cells/values; forbidden suffix, target feedback, or provenance mismatch becomes INTEGRITY_FAILURE and suppresses numbers.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Support for any released exact-run description.

human_boundary.decision_question: Do you ratify the exact composite v9 bytes (bound v7 base, v8 repairs, and v9 lifecycle-test amendment) as the separate controlled lower-bracket pilot, authorizing isolated implementation, independent CPU fixtures, and exactly two no-model environment sealers? After T01--T04, one exact 7B GH200 manifest will be presented once for the required run ratification.
forbidden_before_approval: Implementation, CPU sealing, model calls, training, target cells, GPU use, or result claims before exact composite architecture ratification
Any model/GPU call before T04 approval and later exact run-manifest ratification
Any model-conditioned selected-target action, target-cell result opening/feedback, or training use before exact run authorization
Any Fable program, trace, result, adapter, or threshold used to select, tune, train, or score this pilot
Any hidden repair, substitution, retry, resume, branch salvage, added arm, categorical interpretation, or broadened claim without a new bound change
